name: Boracle
look: a heavy charcoal pig seer on a coiled spring with a purple head under a white pointed hood, a pink snout, white tusks, a necklace of black pearls and a pink crystal ball in a dripping veil of light
entry: It gazes into its crystal ball and tells the fortunes of anyone who brings it food. Its predictions are always right, though it is careful to say only the good ones out loud.
how: Level up a Grumpig at level 45 or higher while it holds a Twisted Spoon (the spoon is used up). It learns Future Sight when it evolves.
